parameters.name: CasterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value that is returned in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, find the ID on the **Cloud Production Studio** page. In the ApsaraVideo Live console, choose **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio**.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.

parameters.name: ComponentId
parameters.description: The component ID. If you add a component to the production studio by calling the [AddCasterComponent](~~2848030~~) operation, use the ComponentId value that is returned in the response.
